name: Brandaleone Lab for Data and Visualization

profile.reading: This facility in Durham County, North Carolina is attributed to Duke Libraries, the library system of Duke University. A Wikipedia fetch for Duke University Libraries described physical library locations and collections, including 96 computer stations at Bostock Library, but these are user facing workstations rather than backend data center infrastructure, and no data center or IT infrastructure detail was found. This is very likely a university owned enterprise or library systems computing facility supporting digital collections, archives, and IT operations rather than a commercial data center.
profile.research_note: Institution confirmed; no specific data center facility detail found. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.
